thread:
olivia-csm: Heads-up — Catalyst just told me their new 'Creator Studio' team went live and is ramping fast. They reported ~3.1x average qps across their workspace in the last 48h and are seeing latency-sensitive realtime summarization jobs. Renewal review in ~9 weeks; they want a plan for multi-team capacity and a short enablement for their infra folks.

sara-cs: Thanks Olivia. Can you drop the raw numbers? qps peak, 95th p95 latency, and token counts would help the capacity ask. Also who on their side will own the infra onboarding?

olivia-csm: Roger. Patch of numbers from Catalyst support chat: 
- baseline qps: 120 req/s
- 48h peak qps: 370 req/s
- avg tokens per req: ~1.6k tokens
- p95 latency: 420ms (generation only)
- 20% of calls hit long-contexts > 8k tokens
They said infra lead is @marcus-catalyst (we can invite). Renewal CSM flagged: finance is watching unit cost, possible consolidation if we can’t hit latency + cost targets.

ian-se: 370 req/s with 1.6k tokens is non-trivial. If they want <500ms p95 we'll need batching + prefix cache. Suggest we propose a Dedicated pilot (2x GPU pods with autoscale to 4 during business hours) as a short-term mitigator.

nina-eng: Agreed. Also need to ensure model variant — are they using LlamaX-13B-8k or the 70B? If they're on 70B, cost explodes. Olivia, any clue which model?

olivia-csm: They started on our default 'redwood-13b-opt' for speed, but their data science team ran tests with a 33B for quality in a few endpoints. Most traffic is on the 13B though.

matt-sre: From infra side I can pre-approve an autoscale policy and reserve burst capacity for a pilot. Two asks: (1) snapshot of their traffic hours (TZ?) and (2) an ETA for inviting their infra folks so we can run a short network/egress check.

olivia-csm: Catalyst is US-EAST heavy, primary hours 9am–6pm ET, small EU footprint. I can schedule a 30-min enablement on Wed 10am ET with Marcus + their SRE.

sara-cs: For the renewal playbook, let's capture: (a) Dedicated pilot cost/benefit, (b) SLO commit (p95 < 500ms for 90% of endpoints), (c) enablement + runbook, (d) monthly usage discount if they commit to 3-month reserved capacity. I'll draft and share with sales.

ian-se: To size the pilot I ran quick math: assume 370 req/s * 1.6k tokens = 592k tokens/s -> ~53M tokens/minute, which is heavy. With KV caching and batching we can likely drop effective token compute by ~35% for repeated prompts. Suggest we present two configs: "latency-optimized" (more pods, smaller batch) vs "cost-optimized" (aggressive batching + cache).

nina-eng: I'll prepare a short evaluation checklist for model and quantization (quantized 13B vs fp16 33B) and include regression tests we should run during pilot. Also add an input validation step for long-context requests to determine cacheability.

matt-sre: I'll provision a small dedicated pool in staging and run a replay of their 48h traffic overnight. Can someone drop a sanitized sample of their traffic? small csv or ndjson ideally.

olivia-csm: I'll ask them for a sanitized sample + Marcus will share their spike window. ETA from Catalyst: today EOD they said they'd send logs.

sara-cs: Sales/account exec @ian-se — can you add a small commercial note: if they go dedicated pilot + convert to reserved within 60 days we can offer a 10% off for Q1 of pilot conversion. Will help renewals.

ian-se: noted, I'll sync with @kaya-sales and add to the proposal.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled test replay job (catalyst-replay-1795001234) started by matt-sre at 1795003000

matt-sre: Replay job kicked off. Will post results (latency percentiles, token throughput, GPU utilization) by EOD tomorrow.

olivia-csm: Thanks team. Action items: (1) Olivia request sanitized logs from Catalyst (EOD), (2) Matt run replay and share metrics, (3) Nina produce eval checklist, (4) Sara + Ian draft pilot commercial + renewal clause, (5) Set enablement Wed 10am ET. I'll ping Marcus to confirm.

sara-cs: Also capturing feedback: Catalyst asked for clearer docs on session cache hints and an example for streaming real-time summarization. Nina — can you add a one-pager?

nina-eng: Yep, I can put together a 1-pager + sample code snippet. Example to include: 
```
// streaming summarization hint
POST /v1/generate 
{
  "model": "redwood-13b-opt",
  "instructions": "stream_summary",
  "cache_hint": { "session_id": "<session>", "prefix_len": 512 }
}
```

olivia-csm: Perfect — that will help reduce their friction. I'll update the ticket once logs arrive.

matt-sre: Posting interim numbers from the replay (partial): after 2h run: p95 generation latency = 380ms on latency-optimized config, GPU util ~76%. Will share full CSV.

olivia-csm: Great progress. I'll loop Marcus into this thread once I have the sanitized payload. :thumbsup:
